findings.title: Missing meta description on home
findings.why: A useful description can influence the snippet shown in search.
findings.evidence: No meta description found in the rendered page.
findings.fix: Add a concise page-specific meta description.
findings.snippet: <meta name="description" content="Acme Widgets builds hand-finished widgets that last for years in busy workshops." />

findings.title: Missing H1 on /pricing
findings.why: The H1 should state the main topic visible on the page.
findings.fix: Add one visible H1 that matches the page purpose.

findings.title: Missing meta description on /about
findings.why: A useful description can influence the snippet shown in search.
findings.evidence: No meta description found in the rendered page.
findings.fix: Add a concise page-specific meta description.
findings.snippet: <meta name="description" content="About Acme Small team, big widgets. Home Pricing" />

findings.title: Social share image incomplete on home
findings.why: This affects how the page looks when shared. It is not a direct ranking claim.
findings.fix: Add 1200x630 Open Graph and Twitter images.
findings.snippet:
<!-- The audited page had no working og:image. Create https://acme-widgets.example/og-image.png (1200x630) or replace it with your real share image. -->
<meta property="og:title" content="Acme Widgets | Durable widgets for small workshops" />
<meta property="og:description" content="Acme Widgets builds hand-finished widgets that last for years in busy workshops." />
<meta property="og:image" content="https://acme-widgets.example/og-image.png" />
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
<meta name="twitter:title" content="Acme Widgets | Durable widgets for small workshops" />
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Acme Widgets builds hand-finished widgets that last for years in busy workshops." />
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://acme-widgets.example/og-image.png" />

findings.title: Images missing alt attributes on home
findings.why: Informative images need alt text for accessibility and image search context.
findings.evidence: 1/1 images have no alt attribute. Intentionally empty alt="" images are treated as decorative, not scored.
findings.fix: Add useful alt text to informative images. Leave decorative images as alt="" intentionally.

findings.title: Apple touch icon missing on home
findings.why: This improves mobile saved-page presentation. It is not a ranking claim.
findings.snippet:
<!-- No icon file loaded at https://acme-widgets.example/apple-touch-icon.png during this audit. Create a square 180x180 PNG there, or point href at your real icon file, before shipping this tag. -->
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="https://acme-widgets.example/apple-touch-icon.png" />
